title: Applications/Systems Engineer - Post-Sales
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
 Role Customer Success Specialist – Pathology \& Sequencing Lab
   

  

 Function Pathology Lab
   

  

 Reporting Regional Manager – Pathology Lab
   

  

 Organization Roche Diagnostics India \& Neighboring Markets
   

  

 Location Bangalore
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The
 **Customer Success Specialist – Pathology \& Sequencing Lab** 
 is a field\-based position \- responsible for providing pre\-sales support, application support and training/education to new and existing sequencing and pathology customers. The primary role of this position is to collaborate with sales, support teams, and serve as the scientific/technical expert to help drive sales and provide support for customers. While some work may be performed remotely, this position requires approximately 50\-60% travel (including overnight travel) to customer sites across India.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Provide scientific support and workflow optimization across pre\- and post\-sales, using broad operational knowledge of diverse brand sequencers to benchmark performance, optimize run parameters, and troubleshoot platform\-specific chemistry or hardware challenges
* Take ownership and drive improvement of technical support for pre\- and post\-sales including troubleshooting and simple data analysis on Roche products for affiliates and customers
* Gather and deliver strategic and competitive feedback, communicating use cases to Global and Regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate and/or perform application training and demonstrations.
* Report on activities in the field on a regular basis to upper management


**Who You Are**
* Experience in sequencing laboratory discipline is required including sample preparation, workflow and target capture
* Experience in teamwork and project management in matrix organization
* A great team player with willingness for travel up to 60% of the time.
* Familiarity with the technological trends and their relevance to the healthcare industry


**Qualification and Experience:**
* Ph.D. or equivalent experience preferred; bachelor’s or master’s Degree with at least 5 years lab experience in molecular biology, biotechnology or appropriate biological or biomedical science field
* At least 5 years of practical application experience in providing applications trainings and support in experimental design, troubleshooting, NGS wet lab experience (library prep, PCR and target enrichment) and troubleshooting a wide variety of commercial sequencing instruments (e.g., Roche, Illumina, Thermo Fisher/Ion Torrent, PacBio, MGI)
* Familiar with bioinformatics software, methodologies and NGS application in oncology
* Solid commercial acumen which can be demonstrated by previous success in bringing the benefits of sales, marketing or operational experience to solve business issues or capitalize on market opportunities
* Clear vision of and commitment to providing outstanding customer service.
* Excellent organization, analytical and systematic troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team towards corporate goals.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Outstanding presentation and training skills.


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Sr Systems Engineer
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
   

  

 For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
   

  

 Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.
   

  

 Title:
 **Sr Systems Engineer**
**Reporting to** 
 : VP, Chief Information Security Officer
   

  

**Location** 
 : Bangalore, India
   

  

**Department** 
 : Information Technology
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Systems Engineer to design, operate, and improve the enterprise systems that support our workforce.
   

  

 This role will work across identity, SaaS applications, endpoints, integrations, automation, collaboration platforms, and IT service delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist who can troubleshoot complex issues, lead improvements, and use automation and AI to make IT more scalable and efficient.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Administer and optimize core enterprise systems and SaaS platforms.
* Support identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, provisioning, and user lifecycle management.
* Manage enterprise productivity, collaboration, and endpoint platforms.
* Build and maintain integrations using APIs, webhooks, scripting, and automation tools.
* Automate repetitive IT processes such as onboarding, offboarding, access requests, and service delivery.
* Support platforms such as Microsoft 365, Okta, Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence.
* Lead troubleshooting for complex system, identity, and application issues.
* Participate in system implementations, migrations, upgrades, and technology improvements.
* Maintain technical standards, documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Partner with Security to ensure appropriate access controls, logging, least privilege, and secure configurations.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other IT team members.


 Automation \& AI
   

  

 A key expectation of this role is to help IT operate more efficiently through automation and AI.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Automating manual workflows and system administration tasks.
* Building scalable integrations between enterprise applications.
* Using AI\-assisted tools for troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, and service delivery.
* Improving employee self\-service and knowledge management.
* Identifying practical AI use cases while maintaining appropriate security and governance controls.


 What We are Looking For
   

  

* 6\+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, IT Engineering, or Enterprise Applications.
* Strong experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience with identity platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.
* Strong knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, SCIM, MFA, and access lifecycle management.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and endpoint management tools such as Intune or Jamf.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Experience with APIs, automation platforms, and scripting such as PowerShell or Python.
* Strong troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently own technical initiatives and work across multiple teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting a cloud\-first or global workforce.
* Experience with Workato, Power Automate, or similar automation platforms.
* Experience with IT asset management and SaaS administration.
* Familiarity with AWS or Azure.
* Experience implementing AI\-enabled IT workflows.
* Relevant Microsoft, Okta, Atlassian, or ITIL certifications are a plus.


 The Profile
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is technically strong, curious, pragmatic, and comfortable owning systems end to end.
   

  

 This is a broad engineering role for someone who can move across identity, SaaS, endpoints, integrations, automation, and AI while keeping reliability, security, and employee experience in mind.
   

  

 Own the system. Simplify the process. Automate where it makes sense. Build for scale.
   

  

**How We Think About AI**
 At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done — not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision\-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Modern Health
* Group Medical Insurance
* Night Shift Allowance
* Hybrid Work Allowance
* Mobile and Internet Allowance
* Meal Benefit
* Office Transportation
* On\-Call Weekend Allowance
* Weekend Working Allowance
* Employee Referral Bonus

title: ITS System Admin/Engr II (CIS), Corporate Infrastructure Product Management
description:
**Description**
 We are looking for a Systems Engineer to join the CIPM AUX Engineering team and own the technical execution layer of our power infrastructure lifecycle program. This is an embedded engineering role within a product management team; you will be the technical hands and eyes of the auxiliary power space, working alongside the Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) who coordinates and owns the overall program.
   

  

 You will lead lab testing and validation of UPS systems, PDUs, and energy management platforms; execute and support pilot deployments at corporate office sites; create and maintain deployment runbooks, firmware control documentation, and RMA processes; and track the health, compliance, and configuration integrity of the production AUX fleet. You will consult on power requirements for Core Network and Compute hardware, evaluate new auxiliary platforms and management software, and ensure that all products meet CIS standards before handover to delivery teams.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of hands\-on power infrastructure work and structured program execution, and who wants to grow their impact in a team that directly shapes energy management strategy at Amazon scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Fleet Lifecycle \& Health Supervision
   

  

* Review quarterly all production Golden Configs (GC)
* Review quarterly firmware status for AUX fleet
* Review quarterly product catalog and runbooks
* Warranty monitoring and troubleshooting
* Coordinate firmware patching schedule with site teams
* Provide Tier\-3 on\-call support for technically complex AUX issues
* Manage ticket queue of technical product issues or documentation updates
* Log defects in tracker; warranty deployments to confirm process is self\-service


 Lab Testing \& Pilot Execution
   

  

* Lead lab proof of concept testing for new UPS/PDU platforms and management software
* Review new product pilot requirements
* Pilot site execution — shadow and reverse shadow deployments
* Conduct training sessions for OID on AUX deployment procedures
* Shadow/reverse shadow knowledge transfer for new UPS/PDU products
* Create and deliver Lunch \& Learn sessions for new auxiliary device standards
* Adhere to CIS standards (develop runbook, coordinate initial integration with SBA and internal tooling)
* Review lab changes, track AUX inventory, propose infrastructure changes to support testing
* Track proof of concept hardware (AUX, Core, Compute) installation and testing requirements


 Technical Documentation
   

  

* Build deployment runbooks (create, validate, iterate)
* Build migration/LCR runbooks (create, validate, iterate)
* Build maintenance and service tracking runbook
* Update monitoring runbook for new products
* Update firmware control document for CVE remediation
* Develop RMA process for auxiliary devices
* Define, test, and release password management process
* Maintain comprehensive tracking of configuration changes within corporate asset management and EMS platforms
* Maintain comprehensive process to track maintenance and incidents
* Test and implement process improvements or technology upgrades to enhance power reliability and operational efficiency


 Technical Design \& Standards Ownership
   

  

* Define and validate technical designs for compute infrastructure deployments
* Validate Bill of Materials (BoM) specifications against site and service requirements
* Help defining hardware configuration tiers to serve multiple customer profiles and budget constraints
* Support vendor evaluation and platform certification efforts, including technical validation of alternative compute platforms


 Automation \& Tooling
   

  

* Test, review, and approve automation processes for AUX infrastructure
* Automation review and testing for deployment and maintenance workflows


 Post\-Deployment Supervision \& Knowledge Transfer
   

  

* Warranty monitoring, troubleshooting, and validation
* On\-call for Tier\-3 issues
* Manage ticket queue of technical product issues or documentation updates
* Coordinate firmware patching schedule with site teams
* Warranty deployments to confirm process is self\-service
* Log defects in tracker


**About The Team**
 Corporate Infrastructure Product Management (CIPM) is responsible for the hardware fleet lifecycle of Amazon's corporate infrastructure, encompassing vendor and platform strategy, firmware and patching compliance, fleet inventory and lifecycle management, and hardware capacity planning. CIPM serves as both product owner and strategic driver of the infrastructure hardware roadmap, collaborating closely with partner engineering and deployment teams across the organization.
   

  

 Within CIPM, the Auxiliary (AUX) Engineering function owns the power distribution and energy management layer that underpins all corporate office infrastructure. The team manages a global fleet of auxiliary power hardware — including UPS systems, PDUs, and environment sensors — across corporate office sites worldwide. This fleet provides reliable, efficient power distribution and power supply to every CIS\-hosted product deployed in corporate offices, covering new builds, lifecycle replacements (LCR), expansions, maintenance, and proof of concept programs. The team onboards new auxiliary products through a repeatable process and validates them against CIS standards and site\-specific requirements, ensuring consistent power reliability at Amazon scale.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of systems engineering experience
* Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
* Experience in data center, networking engineering, systems engineering or construction management with a good understanding of data center technologies such as power, cooling and controls systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems
* Experience with enterprise UPS/PDU platforms from major manufacturers (APC/Schneider Electric, Eaton, Vertiv, or equivalent)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of TCP/IP and networking protocols such as HTTP and DNS
* Experience working in 24/7 production environment
* Experience with service\-oriented architecture and web services
* Exposure to lifecycle replacement programs or hardware end\-of\-life/end\-of\-support planning
* Experience developing or managing RMA processes and warranty tracking for hardware fleets


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**Description**
 Corporate Infrastructure Services (CIS) builds and operates the systems that power Amazon's corporate offices globally — the networks, compute platforms, audio\-visual systems, and operational tooling that every Amazonian depends on. Our Systems Engineering function owns the operational standards, fleet governance, observability, and engineering practices that keep this infrastructure reliable, secure, and cost\-effective across a worldwide footprint.
   

  

 We are looking for a Systems Engineer with a focus on fleet management and operational excellence. You will own the operational health, compliance, and lifecycle management of infrastructure fleets — ensuring that our infrastructure device estates are accurately inventoried, properly governed, and operating within defined standards. You will be the person who knows what we have, where it is, what state it's in, and what needs attention.
   

  

 This role combines hands\-on systems engineering with fleet\-level operational thinking. You will troubleshoot difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and cloud platforms. You will build automation that scales fleet operations — replacing manual processes with repeatable, reliable mechanisms. You will create and maintain the SOPs, runbooks, and documentation that enable consistent operations across a global footprint. You will identify patterns that affect fleet health, performance, and compliance, and drive improvements that deliver measurable results.
   

  

 You will work autonomously, taking ownership of problems even when they cross domain boundaries. You will be proficient across multiple technology areas — operating systems, networking, compute hardware, cloud platforms, and monitoring tools. You will use AWS services (EC2, Lambda, Systems Manager, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, S3, Fleet Manager) and scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to build the automation and tooling that keeps fleet operations efficient and scalable.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the operational health and compliance of infrastructure fleets — maintaining accurate inventory, tracking lifecycle status, and ensuring fleet governance standards are met
* Troubleshoot and resolve difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and operating environments, driving root cause resolution
* Build automation that scales fleet operations — device discovery, compliance scanning, firmware tracking, health monitoring, and lifecycle reporting
* Create, review, and improve SOPs, runbooks, and documentation to ensure consistent, repeatable operations across sites and regions
* Identify patterns that affect fleet performance, reliability, availability, or compliance, and deliver automation that addresses them at scale
* Drive operational excellence initiatives that demonstrate measurable improvements to fleet health, compliance posture, and operational efficiency
* Provide insight to engineers across domains (software, hardware, networking, security) on how their components interact to form a system
* Participate in on\-call rotations, diagnosing and resolving operational issues across the infrastructure estate
* Mentor junior engineers, helping them understand systems architecture, operational practices, and fleet management disciplines
* Contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions with informed operational and fleet perspective


**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration experience
* 5\+ years of Linux experience
* 5\+ years of systems engineering experience
* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
* Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
* Experience working with Linux
* Experience in systems engineering
* Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of TCP/IP and networking protocols such as HTTP and DNS
* Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
* Experience working in 24/7 production environment
* Experience with service\-oriented architecture and web services

title: PLM System Admin
description:
PLM System Admin \- Epiroc Mining India Private Ltd, Bengaluru
   

  

 Join our dynamic and skilled team at Epiroc, a global leader in mining technology, where innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. As a PLM System Admin, you will play a vital role in supporting and enhancing our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions to meet the evolving needs of our worldwide stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This position involves comprehensive ownership of the Teamcenter PLM platform. You will ensure that the system runs reliably, securely, and efficiently, while also developing and customizing Teamcenter to align with specific business requirements. The role demands a balance of platform administration and hands\-on development, allowing you to actively shape and sustain our PLM environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Administer, configure, and maintain the Teamcenter PLM platform, guaranteeing high availability and optimal performance.
* Monitor system health, security, and performance metrics; proactively troubleshoot and resolve issues before they impact users.
* Plan, execute, and manage system upgrades, patches, and integrations collaborating closely with IT and engineering teams.
* Support and guide end\-users by resolving technical problems and continuously improving system usability and reliability.
* Assist in deploying new features, conducting system testing, and automating processes within the PLM ecosystem.
* Document system configurations, operational procedures, and best practices to ensure consistent knowledge sharing and compliance.
* Design, develop, and unit\-test custom Teamcenter solutions using BMIDE, ITK, SOA, and Active Workspace Client (AWC), translating functional specifications into effective technical implementations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by suggesting process optimizations and innovative solutions within the PLM development lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain proofs of concept (POCs) and demos to evaluate new capabilities and demonstrate feasibility to business stakeholders.
* Promptly address and rectify defects identified by testing teams or in production, ensuring comprehensive documentation is maintained ahead of release milestones.


**Required Competencies, Skills, And Experience**
* 4\-7 years of hands\-on experience with Teamcenter administration and development.
* Strong expertise with critical Teamcenter modules including BOM Management (EBOM, MBOM, Process BOM), Change Management, Manufacturing Process Planner, Workflow Designer, Dispatcher, and Transfer Modes.
* In\-depth knowledge of the Teamcenter data model (BMIDE) and deployment methodologies.
* Proficiency in Teamcenter customization leveraging ITK and SOA frameworks, with solid programming skills in C/C\+\+.
* Experience scripting in one or more languages such as JavaScript, SQL, Perl, Batch, XML/XSLT, PowerShell, or Python.
* Comfortable working within Windows Server environments and SQL database management.
* Familiarity and practical experience working in agile settings using tools like Azure DevOps or JIRA.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities paired with excellent communication skills.
* Fluent in written and spoken English; proficiency in Swedish is advantageous but not mandatory.


 Behaviors and Work Style
   

  

 You are a proactive and independent team player who thrives in a multicultural and collaborative environment. With effective interpersonal skills, you excel at working alongside colleagues from diverse IT disciplines across the globe, nurturing positive engagement and information sharing. Your problem\-solving mindset and strong communication skills help you deliver quality solutions while supporting the PLM community effectively.
   

  

 Why Choose Epiroc?
   

  

 At Epiroc, you will join a workplace that celebrates creativity, innovation, and diversity with over 113 nationalities represented globally. We emphasize personal and professional growth through continuous learning opportunities provided by Epiroc University, alongside a comprehensive benefits package that includes flexible working hours and performance bonuses, helping you maintain a healthy work\-life balance.
   

  

 This role offers unparalleled global career development prospects within a company committed to community involvement and sustainability. Become part of a team that lives its core values—Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation—and makes a decisive impact in the mining industry through advanced digital solutions.
   

  

 Location and Employment Details
   

  

* Position based in Bengaluru, India.
* Full\-time position within the Corporate Units business area, specifically in the PLM\-Manufacturing department under the IT job area.
* Employment under Epiroc Mining India Private Ltd with a regular employee group status.


 We are excited to receive applications from individuals eager to contribute to our mission of continuously enhancing PLM solutions while growing their career in a supportive, innovative, and global environment.
   

  

**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
   

  

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 Company Description:
   

  

 As the world's leader in digital payments technology, Visa's mission is to connect the world through the most creative, reliable and secure payment network \- enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. The company's dedication to innovation drives the rapid growth of connected commerce on any device, and fuels the dream of a cashless future for everyone, everywhere. As the world moves from analog to digital, Visa is applying our brand, products, people, network and scale to reshape the future of commerce.
   

  

 At Visa, your individuality fits right in. Working here gives you an opportunity to impact the world, invest in your career growth, and be part of an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are a global team of disruptors, trailblazers, innovators and risk\-takers who are helping drive economic growth in even the most remote parts of the world, creatively moving the industry forward, and doing meaningful work that brings financial literacy and digital commerce to millions of unbanked and underserved consumers. Visa is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. You're an Individual, We're the team. Together, let's transform the way the world pays.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 For Visa to deliver on the vision of the best way to pay and be paid for everyone, everywhere, Product Reliability Engineer (PRE) must provide best\-in\-class infrastructure and applications services that are secure, scalable, continuously available, and run on software\-defined infrastructures. As an Product Reliability Engineer, We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day.
   

  

* The candidate will work as a technical expert to drive the issue bridges, provide fixes and follow the production best practices.
* Engage with cross\-functional co\-located teams in design, development and implementation of enterprise scalable features related to enabling higher developer productivity, environment monitoring and self\-healing, and facilitate autonomous delivery teams.
* Support, troubleshoot and analyze code on all 3 layers of the stack related to infrastructure, middleware, and continuous integration and delivery frameworks.
* You will meet the strict OLA and SLA commitments and work closely with the internal teams to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the systems.
* You will support process improvements which guide the development, sustaining \& support activities, will work cross functionally with other business departments to align activities and deliverables.
* Integrating Code Quality tools and Code Analysis tools into IDE’s.
* The candidate will demonstrate technology expertise and system knowledge to keep the system stable with zero impact to the business. Work with cross\-functional co\-located teams in design \& development to enable higher productivity, environment monitoring and self\-healing capability.
* Will be responsible for programming a feature and or a feature set that will enhance our availability, resilience and Security. You will establish foundation for future implementations and automation requirements in the environment.
* You will be primary in investigating root cause of severe and systemic outages \& identify corrective actions.
* Troubleshoot and conduct root cause analysis to address and resolve issues and keep them from repeating.
* Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
* Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Will provide impact assessment and mitigation plan for changes going into the production environment and predication of successful rate of changes planned in the environment.
* Performing code and quality reviews, managing operations, triaging and fixing operational and application issues.


****Qualifications****
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from reputed college.
* We are looking for a talented, technical, proactive, energetic, self\-motivated and passionate person who embraces challenges and is a proven problem solver.
* Stay on top of the open source technology and be ready to learn/adopt new technology continuously.
* Discuss, collaborate and promote architectural best practices across technology organization.
* Be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the track as we continue to push technology forward.
* The ability to tackle challenges and address problems head\-on.
* Strong ability to collaborate.
* Highly driven, inventive and results oriented.
* Be passionate to work on cool technologies.
* Ability to debug, optimize code, and automate routine tasks.
* Systematic problem\-solving approach, coupled with effective communication skills and a sense of drive.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
